searchScope: every tracked and untracked file of the repository, artifacts excluded
onlyUse: PackageIcon in src/Directory.Build.props, which packed the root copy into every package. The copy under src was referenced by nothing.

afterRemoval.noticeStatement: records the removal in one sentence

legalRecords: Both paths leave the commentless-exception set: they were listed because a changed binary cannot carry an in-file comment, and a file that no longer exists is not a changed file. The regenerated ChangeList records both as deletions under their upstream names.
keptDeliberately: The two logo-token mapping rules in tools/identity/identity_rules.py. They record how the upstream token was mapped during the identity wave and are checked against synthetic probes, not against the tree; four guard tests pin all 41 rules. Removing them is a separate decision.
alsoRemoved: The format exception for tests/ViciOne.ServiceBus.KafkaIntegration.Tests/KafkaMessage.avsc, a file the tree does not contain: no tracked path contains Kafka at all.
